##### Project general facts

Chic Tower by DAMAC Properties, created with the master jeweller de GRISOGONO, is a wellness-focused ultra-luxury residential tower overlooking the canal. Designed as a branded residence inspired by the healing properties of turquoise, the tower reflects the signature aesthetic of the jewellery house and combines waterfront views with immediate access to the key business and lifestyle districts of the city.

The tower is centred around a wellness-driven lifestyle concept. Residents are welcomed into a lobby designed with active lifestyle elements, including workout benches and weights, while the podium extends into a full spa experience with restorative baths and beauty treatment areas. An outdoor gym with calisthenics equipment and state-of-the-art fitness facilities complete an offer built around continuous wellbeing throughout the building.

Interiors feature luxury finishes and high-quality materials throughout all living spaces, with fully equipped kitchens designed for functionality and modern convenience. Generous windows bring in natural light and frame views of the canal and the skyline. Homes are delivered unfurnished, with fitted kitchens only, maintaining a clean, customisable interior standard for each owner to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is a dynamic central district along the Dubai Water Canal, combining office towers, hotels, residential buildings and waterfront promenades. Fine dining, boutique cafes, gyms, art spaces and supermarkets line the canal and the surrounding streets, creating a vibrant urban atmosphere within walking distance of Downtown Dubai and its landmark attractions.

Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road and Financial Centre Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Business Bay metro station is close by. The Dubai Water Canal promenade is a short walk away, Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall are close by, and the Dubai International Financial Centre, City Walk and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Business Bay is a freehold district open to international buyers and one of the most liquid residential markets in Dubai. Proximity to Downtown Dubai and the main business districts attracts professionals, entrepreneurs and short-stay guests, supporting high occupancy and strong rental demand. Branded canal-side residences with distinctive concepts underpin premium rental rates and long-term value for investors.
